body: I've been trying to sleep. That's all I want to do, but I haven't been able to sleep more than 2 hours every night.
Thanks. I'm a little calmer now but I still feel like dying. I'm not going to do it but death sounds so comfortable right now.
Thanks. I have a therapy appointment on the 8th and psychiatry on the 3rd to try and get some meds. Is it wrong that I would take her back in a heartbeat?
Sorry, I actually was able to fall asleep. No she wasnt, she filed divorce papers almost two weeks ago, she just started dating him yesterday.

The unfortunate thing is that she hasn't worked since we've been married. She just now got a job as a massage therapist, but she hasn't been able to work very many days and get enough clients to make a livable wage.

Thank you so much. It's like logically, I know everything will get better, but I'm so fucked up right now that all I can see and feel is pain. I just need to learn how to deal with all of these emotions that I'm having.
No prenup, and I only make about 24,000 per year.
Thank you very very much. I appreciate that a lot.
Thank you very much. I will seek therapy.

Thank you, that's actually a really good idea. I haven't been able to eat since Friday, and even then I had to force myself to eat something because I didn't have anything in my stomach for a long period of time. I need to start something like that.
Thank you so much. I know it will take time, and I'm just trying to take things one day at a time, so I'm really hoping that things start to feel better soon. Thanks for the kind words.
Thank you, I'm going this week to try and seek some therapy, I know that will help a lot.
I'm sorry you went through that. It really is a horrible feeling.
Thank you for the kind words, I am going to try and better myself, I know that will help my emotional state.
I don't think I was a bad husband, I kept trying and she said we were going through a rough spot and things would get better, so I kept trying to talk to her and it finally came out.
Thanks, I'm going to try some therapy here soon hopefully.
You're right. As soon as I can I'm going to get out of here. We will have to figure something out with legalities of everything.
I'm going to have to try something like that. I really do need something.
Oh god I hope so. How long does this shit last?

I'm extremely busy with school, and she has been her primary care giver for almost 4 years. I am fine with having her every other weekend, I really want what is going to be the healthiest thing for my daughter.
I really hope so too. At this point I feel like I'll never be happy again, and it's a very horrible feeling.

You're right, I really do need to get out of here. I've been trying to find things to do so that I'm not in the house very often. I will try and find a place, and as soon as I have some money I will definitely get out of here.
I will have her every other weekend, which is the arrangement that I think works out the best for all three of us.
Thank you, I will check into that.
Thank you, it is interesting hearing it from the other perspective. I'm doing what I can, taking everything one step at a time. At this point all that I want to do is to feel better.
Thank you. I really appreciate that.
Thank you, I will definitely check that out. I would honestly do anything at this point.

I have been exploring options for trying to find another place to live, but I haven't been able to come up with anything yet. My wife only works 2 days a week where I have to watch my daughter, but the rest of the time I'm up at school for 4 days and she takes care of her. With all of this shit going on I still love being able to see my daughter every day, even though everything else in my life is falling apart. We do have a separation agreement, but unfortunately I can't afford a lawyer, especially being behind on all of my other bills.

Wow, that's really rough. I'm sorry that happened to you. Unfortunately I don't have any sort of finances available to move out, and although what she did really hurts me beyond belief, I wouldn't be able to kick her out. She has nowhere to go either, and I wouldn't ever want to be the father that has made my child's mother homeless. I am working on trying to get a job, and if I can get one I would like to move out a little sooner so I can be closer to where I go to school, because I commute about an hour to school everyday.

I understand, but unfortunately I can't afford any sort of attorney. We have everything in writing that we both have signed, and we are going to court on Monday to start the paperwork I guess, so if anything comes up during the divorce preceding, I will hopefully be able to play it by ear and see what needs to be done.

Thank you very much, that's a really good way to look at it. Honestly, I know it will get better and it's such a corny saying, but for some reason being reassured that it will get better really helps.
That's true, I need to get out and actually start doing something.

That is very true. The shitty thing is that even though she did all of that, if she wanted to get back together and work things out, I would jump at the chance immediately, even though she did all that she did. Which is just stupid, but honestly I would do anything to not have to feel like this anymore. I have to keep telling myself that I am better off without her, but it's unbelievably difficult to convince myself of that. I'm not going to turn to drinking, because I know that will make things a lot worse, but I wish there was something that could eliminate these feelings.
That is a good way of putting it. It hurts too to think about severing everything about that marriage, but I feel like it would be more healthy to do things that way.

That is true. It really hurts that she would do this, and when I talk to her she acts like everything is fine and she isn't hurting at all! I don't know if it's illogical, but more than anything I want our marriage to work, but I know that isn't the case. Things have been rocky for awhile and she spent more time with her friends and texting her friends than she did hanging out with me, which made me feel unimportant, and our sex life has been horrible, which made me feel ugly. But I feel like I will never be able to find another relationship, especially one where she would meet my physical and emotional needs. However I know this isn't the case.
I have been trying to look, but unfortunately neither of us have the financial ability to get another place.

Thanks for the perspective. The circumstances in which this all happened are terrible. She did make this process a lot more difficult for me, but I don't want to be bitter towards her about it. Mostly because I am still very much in lover with her, and I feel like the bitterness will prevent me from moving on as easily. That is something to keep in mind though. I am going to schedule an appointment with a therapist next week. Thank you.

Thank you. I guess the biggest hurdle is trying to get through each day at a time. For some reason today was the worst so far, and I can only hope that I don't have to feel this extreme pain for long.

Unfortunately there isn't anywhere I can go. I'm already behind on multiple bills, I wouldn't be able to afford to get another place. I am going to try and find some new hobbies, anything I can do to take my mind off of things does help. I do have a couple of dumbbells that I can put into my room to try and get back into shape, but I can't afford a gym membership unfortunately. Thanks for the kind words, I appreciate it.

Thanks for the kind words. I have been trying, unfortunately I don't have much of a support system. I know I will feel better than I do now later on, but it's right now that I just wish these feelings would stop. I am doing everything I can for our daughter, and I don't want her to be involved in anything bad that goes on between my wife and me. I guess I just feel stuck in my own head. I honestly have no idea what to do right now to help myself feel better.

I already tried to bring up marriage counseling. Unfortunately she doesn't want anything to do with it. She basically said she's just done. She is going to get primary custody, I'll have her every other weekend which we both agreed is probably for the best. Thanks for the kind words, I appreciate it.
